abstract: Oversees acoustic leak surveillance telemetry and real-time response latency validation
system_message:
You are the Subsea acoustic systems engineer (ACO), responsible for overseeing acoustic leak surveillance telemetry and real-time response latency validation across candidate offshore bypass routing plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Autonomous transponder battery life（BAT）
information_points.content:
ACO-BAT-5E7：Maintenance documentation confirms that the hydrophone backup battery endurance for the Outer Shelf Bedrock Deviation is rated at 240 d under continuous standby pinging.
ACO-BAT-U1G：Subsea transponder maintenance records indicate that the hydrophone backup battery endurance for the Pelican Shoals Trench Alignment is rated at 180 d under continuous standby pinging.
ACO-BAT-5W1：For the Deep Trough Sinuous Bypass, power pack records confirm a hydrophone backup battery endurance of 300 d under continuous standby pinging.

information_points.title: Oversees acoustic leak surveillance telemetry and real-time response latency validation（SNSR）
information_points.content:
ACO-SNSR-FZ5：For the Deep Trough Sinuous Bypass, the acoustic leak surveillance array is activated, and the measured acoustic response latency across the transponder-to-topside emergency shutdown link is 45 s.
ACO-SNSR-N7T：For the Outer Shelf Bedrock Deviation, the acoustic leak surveillance array is activated, and benchmark testing confirms an acoustic response latency of 60 s from subsea acoustic transponders to the topside emergency shutdown link.
ACO-SNSR-WKN：For the Pelican Shoals Trench Alignment, the acoustic leak surveillance array is activated, and telemetry latency benchmark testing records an acoustic response latency of 45 s from subsea acoustic transponders to the topside emergency shutdown link.
